events.verdict: Nance Jr. (CLE) sets the pick in Allen's (NYK) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Allen (NYK) and Smith Jr. (NYK) make marginal contact to the body of Dellavedova (CLE) during his shooting motion on his driving shot attempt.
Clarkson (CLE) makes marginal contact to the body of Knox (NYK) during the drive as Nwaba (CLE) cleanly strips the ball.
Nwaba (CLE) cleanly dislodges the ball from Knox (NYK).
Smith Jr. (NYK) makes incidental contact to Clarkson's (CLE) hand on the ball as he dislodges the ball during his drive.
Smith Jr. (NYK) and Clarkson (CLE) make incidental contact with one another during the loose ball.
Robinson (NYK) sets the screen in Nwaba's (CLE) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Nwaba (CLE) briefly places an arm around Kornet's (NYK) hip but does not prevent him from disengaging through the screen.
Smith Jr. (NYK) legally contests the jump shot attempt by Dellavedova (CLE).
Nwaba (CLE) moves laterally into the path of Allen (NYK) at the start of the drive but the contact is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
Sexton (CLE) initiates contact with Kornet (NYK), who is in a legal picking position, but the contact is marginal and does not affect his FOM.
Allen (NYK) commits a take foul on Sexton (CLE).
Kornet (NYK) commits a take foul on Clarkson (CLE).
Knox (NYK) makes marginal contact with Clarkson (CLE) during the inbound.
Jenkins (NYK) sets the screen in Nwaba's (CLE) path and initiates some contact, but the contact is marginal and does not affect Nwaba's ability to defend.
Dellavedova (CLE) makes marginal contact with Kornet (NYK) that does not affect his ability to set the pick.
Knox (NYK) sets the screen in Clarkson's (CLE) path and does not prevent him from disengaging from the contact.
Robinson (NYK) makes contact with the ball and the part of Nance Jr.'s (CLE) hand that is on the ball, cleanly dislodging it during the rebound.
Smith Jr. (NYK) takes more than two steps after he has gathered the ball.
LLB shows Smith Jr. (NYK) does not step out of bounds after securing the rebound.
All available angles show Nwaba (CLE) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (NYK) jump shot attempt.
